t: What Code as Music Systems Is
title: What Code as Music Systems Is
definition: Code as Music Systems: hearing program structure as music.
description:
Code as Music Systems — Signature Edition: hearing program structure as music. This is the JAH-original vision, designed from first principles and labeled as Signature speculation throughout.

The Signature system hulls program starts where public roadmaps stop. t: 2029 — First system hulls IDE ships: developers describe intent and rec
title: 2029 — First system hulls IDE ships: developers describe intent and rec
definition: 2029 milestone on the Code as Music Systems roadmap.
description:
First system hulls IDE ships: developers describe intent and receive mapping design-verified sonification engines code.

What must be true first: the sonification engines results have to replicate outside the lab, system logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and mapping design operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed sonification engines demonstrations, system logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting mapping design uptime. When all three flash green, 2029 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (3 years from the 2026 baseline.)

definition: Estimates Code as Music Systems readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Code as Music Systems components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a system hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

t: Code as Music Systems Simulator
title: Code as Music Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Code as Music Systems operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Code as Music Systems installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 79380 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where sonification engines monitoring, system logistics redundancy, or mapping design maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

t: Code as Music Systems Master Roadmap
title: Code as Music Systems Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Code as Music Systems: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Code as Music Systems — hearing program structure as music.

Phase 1 — Prove (sonification engines): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (system logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (mapping design): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (debugging by ear): system hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and developers-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
